title: The realization equation of the scalar summand diagram
statement: For the actual diagram D of finite R, p:X→Y, P,Q and a+b=n, D.j1 ≫ D.l2 = D.a2 ≫ D.j2. This is its native field compatibility, with no additional assumptions.

proof.text: Unfold the realization edge and its injections. Apply the native realization injection formula to the two fixed inverse-image complexes. The complete transport to the diagram fields is proved in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteScalarTensorDiagram_realization
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (P Q : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R))) ℤ)
    (a b n : ℤ) (h : a + b = n) :
    let D := finiteScalarTensorSummandDiagram R p P Q a b n h
    D.j1 ≫ D.l2 = D.a2 ≫ D.j2
